evidence.reason: The recursive mkdir at line 281 can create missing ancestor directories, but the code later fsyncs only the ledger file's immediate directory, not each newly created directory entry in its parent. On a crash after consume returns consumed, a newly created nested ledger directory can be lost together with the nonce, permitting replay. Recursive creation is supported and no durable pre-created directory is required, so this is an implementation durability defect rather than a new requirement.
